title: Normalized ordinary quotient tensor unit and associator
statement: Let $J$ be an essentially small site, $O$ a commutative ring, $\ell\in O$, and $B_n=(O/(\ell^{n+1}))_J$ [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension]. Let $T_{mn}$ be the prescribed sheafified scalar-extension functor for $n\leq m$, with its ordinary adjunction normalized by $x\mapsto1\otimes x$. There are isomorphisms $u_n:T_{nn}\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $a_{lmn}:T_{lm}T_{mn}\cong T_{ln}$. On underlying additive sheaves, $u_n$ composed with the scalar-extension unit is the identity, and $a_{lmn}$ composed with the two successive scalar-extension units equals the direct scalar-extension unit. These equations specify the normalized comparisons, including repeated indices.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary tensor coherence in the general strict-system extension theory to the diagram of constant quotient coefficient rings. For each scalar map, identify the supplied tensor model with the prescribed tensor functor by component isomorphisms coming from its object and morphism formulas.

The normalized scalar-unit formula identifies the model unit with the prescribed unit after that component isomorphism. Transport the model tensor unit and associator. Naturality of the model unit cancels the intermediate component isomorphisms, leaving precisely the prescribed underlying additive-sheaf equations.

theorem coefficientTensorOrdinaryCoherence :
    ∃ unit : ∀ n, coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) (Nat.le_refl n) ≅ 𝟭 _,
      CoefficientTensorUnitNormalized unit ∧
      ∃ assoc : ∀ {l m n} (h₁ : m ≤ l) (h₂ : n ≤ m),
        coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h₁ ⋙
          coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) h₂ ≅
            coefficientTensor (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell) (h₂.trans h₁),
        CoefficientTensorAssocNormalized assoc
